Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you
reported. Please state your full understanding of what happened.
A: I was driving through an intersection in Pearland, Texas, and I was turning left. I had a green light, or at least I
thought I did when I started to turn. Then a vehicle coming the other way hit the front passenger side of my car.
Q: Had you come to a complete stop before beginning the turn?
A: No, I was moving slowly through the turn, maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour. I was watching for oncoming traffic,
but the other car came in faster than I expected.
Q: Were there any other vehicles involved or any witnesses you are aware of?
A: No other vehicles that I saw. A man in a pickup stopped afterward and asked if I was okay, but I didn't get his
information.
Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. My neck was stiff and sore right away, and by the next
morning I had pain running into my shoulders and a headache. They diagnosed me with whiplash and gave me a
neck brace and some muscle relaxers.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes. Turning my head to check mirrors hurts, and I have trouble sleeping. I've been going to physical therapy twice
a week.
Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add or correct in your account?
A: Only that I want to make sure it's clear I wasn't speeding. I was being careful.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
</page>
